idea: Basic plumbing maintenance every homeowner should know
title: Simple Steps to Protect Your Home Plumbing
description: Taking care of your home plumbing starts with a few simple habits. First, know the location of your main water shut-off valve and test it twice a year to ensure it turns smoothly during an emergency. Clean drain strainers weekly to prevent hair and soap scum from causing stubborn blockages, and never pour grease or oil down the kitchen sink. Finally, inspect beneath sinks every month for subtle moisture spots or slow drips that can lead to hidden water damage. Routine attention keeps your fixtures reliable. If you encounter persistent leaks or low water pressure, contact a licensed plumber for a thorough inspection.
